title: VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code on the Game Gear (S1)
description: The Game Gear port of VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code (docs/projects/sega-vrun-ports-plan.md, S1): the Game Boy version's physics C copied unchanged (tick-identical to Eternal Degrade), the Game Boy Color's colours, PSG sound (the effects converted from the Game Boy's, the placeholder songs through a PSG music driver), saves in the cartridge's battery RAM. Built with SDCC 4.6.0 + devkitSMS (toolchains.json) in its live workspace PROJECTS/VRUN_VOC_GG_dev (its own git, local only).

toolchain: SDCC 4.6.0 and devkitSMS 533ae57, pinned in toolchains.json (SMSlib and crt0 rebuilt from devkitSMS's sources by build.ps1)

steps.name: build
steps.note: build.ps1: SMSlib_GG and crt0 rebuilt once (build/smslib-gg), sdcc -mz80 -DTARGET_GG, the units of src/units.txt in their banks, makesms; checks the banks, the stack, 'TMR SEGA' and the Game Gear region code (7).

run.note: 1 = A, 2 = B, Start pauses (the pause saves; Start+1 on the pause saves again); Start+1 in a run is the Game Boy's Select (the abort lottery).

memory.what: a run is going (A on the title)
the frame interrupt runs every frame
the run's ticks go on (24 a second)

scenarios.why: power-on, the title, A starts a run, a few moves

compat.what: The game on every Game Gear emulator BrokenDev has: power-on, A on the title at frame 60 (the Game Boy Color's comparison scenario), the run's start frame and ticks read by the build's symbols.

checks.what: A on the title started a run

comparison.what: S1: the Game Gear port against VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code on the Game Boy Color (project vrun-voc), the strict Vaults tolerance: the same events on the same ticks, the same positions. Both sides' physics state (_voc: the same C struct, the same offsets) and their run tick counter (_tick_count, from the run's start: origin mode=1); the pads by frame (the port starts its run at the Game Boy Color's frame).

knownIssues: No hardware test on the user's Genesis flash cart yet (its built-in Game Gear mode).
